rapid_table.py in this folder contains code from RapidTable 3.0.2
(https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidTable), Copyright (c) RapidAI (SWHL), which includes
code from PaddleOCR's PP-Structure, Copyright (c) 2020 PaddlePaddle Authors. All Rights
Reserved. Both are licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
(rapid_table-LICENSE.txt in this folder).

The code was modified for a11y-stem on 2026-10-09; the changes are listed at the top of
rapid_table.py.

The SLANet-plus model weights the code runs (slanet-plus.onnx, downloaded at build time,
not part of this repository) are PaddlePaddle's, released under the Apache License,
Version 2.0, and distributed by RapidAI.
